Light.text: An object you touch sheds bright light in a 20-ft radius and dim light for another 20 ft. If cast on an object held by a hostile creature, it gets a Dex save to avoid it.

Sacred Flame.text: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see. Dex save or 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover.

Thaumaturgy.text: A minor wonder: your voice booms, flames flicker, the ground trembles harmlessly, a door slams open, or your eyes change.

Mage Hand.text: A spectral hand appears and can manipulate objects, open doors, or carry up to 10 lb. Move it 30 ft as an action.

Prestidigitation.text: A minor magical trick: a spark, a smell, clean or soil an object, chill or warm food, a small illusion or mark.

Ray of Frost.text: Ranged spell attack. On a hit, 1d8 cold damage and the target's speed is reduced by 10 ft until the start of your next turn.

Shocking Grasp.text: Melee spell attack, with advantage if the target wears metal armor. On a hit, 1d8 lightning damage and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

Bless.text: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws. Upcast: +1 creature per slot level.

Command.text: Speak a one-word command (Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt). Wis save or the target obeys on its next turn. Upcast: +1 target per slot level.

Comprehend Languages (ritual).text: Understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear, and read any written language you touch.

Cure Wounds.text: A creature you touch regains 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP. No effect on undead or constructs. Upcast: +1d8 per slot level.

Detect Magic.text: Sense magic within 30 ft. Use an action to see a faint aura around visible magical creatures or objects and learn its school.

Detect Magic (ritual).text: Sense magic within 30 ft. Use an action to see a faint aura around visible magical creatures or objects and learn its school.

Guiding Bolt.text: Ranged spell attack. On a hit, 4d6 radiant damage and the next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage. Upcast: +1d6 per slot level.

Healing Word.text: A creature you can see regains 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP. Upcast: +1d4 per slot level.

Mage Armor.text: A willing unarmored creature's base AC becomes 13 + Dex modifier (15 for Aren). Ends if the target dons armor.

Magic Missile.text: Three darts of force, each dealing 1d4 + 1 damage to a creature you can see. They hit automatically and can target the same or different creatures. Upcast: +1 dart per slot level.

Protection from Evil and Good.text: Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead have disadvantage on attacks against the warded creature, which also can't be charmed, frightened or possessed by them.

Ray of Sickness.text: Ranged spell attack. On a hit, 2d8 poison damage and the target must make a Con save or be poisoned until the end of your next turn. Upcast: +1d8 per slot level.

Sanctuary.text: Any creature that targets the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wis save or choose a new target. Ends if the warded creature attacks or casts a harmful spell.

Shield.time: 1 reaction (when hit or targeted by magic missile)
Shield.text: +5 to AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack. You take no damage from magic missile.

Shield of Faith.text: A creature you can see gains +2 AC for the duration.

Sleep.text: Roll 5d8: that many HP of creatures within 20 ft of a point fall unconscious, lowest current HP first. Undead and creatures immune to charm are unaffected. Upcast: +2d8 per slot level.

Thunderwave.text: Each creature in a 15-ft cube from you makes a Con save: 2d8 thunder damage and pushed 10 ft on a failure, half damage and no push on a success. Audible 300 ft away. Upcast: +1d8 per slot level.

Flaming Sphere.text: A 5-ft sphere of fire. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 ft of it makes a Dex save: 2d6 fire damage, half on a success. As a bonus action, move it 30 ft and ram a creature for the same save. Upcast: +1d6 per slot level.

Hold Person.text: A humanoid you can see makes a Wis save or is paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Upcast: +1 humanoid per slot level.

Invisibility.text: A creature you touch becomes invisible, along with anything it wears or carries. Ends if the target attacks or casts a spell. Upcast: +1 creature per slot level.

Misty Step.text: Teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.

Shatter.text: A painful ringing in a 10-ft radius sphere. Each creature makes a Con save: 3d8 thunder damage, half on a success. Creatures made of stone, metal or crystal have disadvantage. Upcast: +1d8 per slot level.

Lesser Restoration.text: End one disease or one of these conditions on a creature you touch: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

Spiritual Weapon.text: A floating spectral weapon appears. When cast, and as a bonus action on later turns, move it 20 ft and make a melee spell attack: 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier force damage.
